notes: lanes' Copilot model (--model): mai-code-2; premium multiplier: unknown (listModels() gives no billing multiplier for mai-code-2)
the multiplier is unknown: a lane without session.shutdown totals counts its user calls once each, which undercounts a model above 1x

the --max-requests bound: each run gets the requests left as its own hard cap (omg factory run --max-requests): it starts no lane once its lanes recorded that many, so the bench can end above --max-requests only by the one lane each run has in flight when it reaches its cap

live runs leave state outside <fixture>: the local forge mirror ~\.omg\state\forge\local\repo-348e913dbf14.git and the factory ledger dir ~\.omg\factory-ledger (claims, private run repositories, tamper holds). To remove them: omg factory run cancel <id>, then omg factory run clean <id> --seed in <fixture>\repo for each run, then delete the mirror dir
